description: This file defines a Drupal Views filter plugin class 'Date' for filtering date/time fields, extending numeric date filtering capabilities with custom validation, date formatting, and timezone handling.

classes.name: Date
classes.description: A Drupal Views filter plugin class for date/time filtering, extending NumericDate with custom validation, date formatting, and timezone handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the date formatter, request stack, and setting date format based on field storage type.

methods.name: validateExposed
methods.description: Validates the exposed filter input to ensure it is a valid date, setting an error if invalid.

methods.name: opBetween
methods.description: Overrides parent method to handle date filtering with 'between' operator, formatting dates for SQL query.

methods.name: opSimple
methods.description: Overrides parent method for simple date comparisons, formatting date values for query.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Determines the appropriate timezone for date calculations based on storage format.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Calculates the timezone offset in seconds for a given date/time string and timezone.
